snapshot.note: Strategy catalog is a documented framework. Betting-line, odds, prop and correlation values are NOT official league values; they require a model run over verified inputs and are left blank/UNVERIFIED until computed.

gates.requirement: Every signal input traces to an official league/team/network source; no secondary or unverified input enters a live signal.
A strategy must have at least the documented minimum number of historical, settled bets before it is ranked or rewarded.
Performance must beat a no-skill baseline (Brier score / log loss) with statistical significance; variance explained must exceed a preset threshold.
Inter-leg correlation within any multi-leg bet must stay below the documented cap; correlated legs are re-weighted or dropped.
Results are evaluated only on out-of-sample folds; no in-sample performance is used for ranking.
Per-bet and per-strategy exposure stays within documented caps to control drawdown.
A strategy must be fully reproducible from its documented inputs and parameters before it is accepted to the leaderboard.

strategies.name: Straight Spread
strategies.signal: Model-originated point spread vs. the verified market line; bet the edge where model and market disagree.
strategies.inputs: Team strength (official standings), injured-starter adjustments, situational factors.
strategies.skill_metric: Brier score, log loss, ROI vs. baseline

strategies.name: Moneyline
strategies.signal: Model win probability vs. market-implied probability; positive expected value on the straight win.
strategies.inputs: Team strength, home/away, injury adjustments, scoring margin.

strategies.name: Total (Over/Under)
strategies.signal: Model total points vs. market total; bet the side where model and market diverge.
strategies.inputs: Offensive/defensive efficiency, pace, weather, injured-skill absences.

strategies.name: Multi-Game Spread Parlay
strategies.signal: Combine 2–4 single-bet spread legs; accept only when combined edge survives the correlation cap.
strategies.inputs: Per-leg model spreads, inter-game correlation estimates.
strategies.correlation: Pairwise correlation capped (documented max); drop/re-weight legs above cap.
strategies.gates: VG-1, VG-2, VG-3, VG-4, VG-5, VG-6, VG-7

strategies.name: Same-Game Parlay
strategies.signal: Combine team + player legs within one game; correlation is structurally higher and must be measured.
strategies.inputs: Model spread/total + player prop estimates for the same game.
strategies.correlation: Same-game correlation measured per position group; cap enforced; legs above cap removed.
strategies.gates: VG-1, VG-2, VG-3, VG-4, VG-5, VG-6, VG-7

strategies.name: Passing Yards Prop
strategies.signal: Model passing-yardage projection for a QB vs. the market prop line.
strategies.inputs: QB efficiency, opponent pass defense, game script, injured offensive-line absences.

strategies.name: Rushing Yards / TD Prop
strategies.signal: Model rushing-yardage and/or touchdown projection for a RB vs. the market prop line.
strategies.inputs: RB usage, opponent run defense, goal-line splits, offensive-line health.

strategies.name: Player Prop Combo Parlay
strategies.signal: Combine 2–3 player props (e.g. QB yards + RB yards + team total) into one correlated parlay.
strategies.inputs: Multiple player-prop projections, inter-prop correlation, game total.
strategies.correlation: Inter-prop correlation measured (skill-position and team correlation); cap enforced.
strategies.gates: VG-1, VG-2, VG-3, VG-4, VG-5, VG-6, VG-7
